body:
Good morning, Bakersfield. It’s Tuesday, August 18, 2026, and we’re starting the day with a high near 101° under a moderate air quality alert of 97. Overnight, a truck fire west of town escalated into a wildland response, and a 53-foot trailer went fully involved north of Pond. Today’s top story: fake AI videos are falsely promising Kern County seniors they can freeze property taxes or skip school-bond charges. Let’s get you caught up.

## The Kern Overnight

A truck fire that tipped over and burned down a trailer west of Bakersfield escalated into a wildland response around 9:47 p.m. last night. Multiple engines, a dozer, helicopter 409 and a water tender were among the resources ordered as the fire pushed into the hillside. Crews worked to access the burn, with a reporting party pointing out lights on the hill during the response.

Around 3:45 a.m., a 53-foot trailer north of Pond on Garzoli Road was fully involved, with a spot of grass fire spreading alongside it. Battalion crews responded to what dispatch dubbed the Garzoli Incident and remained on scene for hotspots.

Just before 10:45 p.m., a caller reported roughly 30 shots fired, mostly in a field in the area of Panama Lane and South Allen Road. The call stood for service while units investigated.

Around 3:06 a.m., a welfare check near the Wells Fargo on Columbus Street escalated when a man on a bicycle was approached by subjects and an impact sound was heard, followed by a fight involving three people. Two suspects fled northbound Columbus; units searched.

Just after 4 a.m., a big-rig incident with a load of table grapes brought a roadway closure in Delano, with Environmental Health notified.

## Today's weather

Expect a high near 101° and a low around 73° tonight. It’s currently 95° at Meadows Field (KBFL). A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect until 11:00 p.m. tonight. Air quality is moderate at 97.

## Top stories

**23ABC reports that fake AI videos falsely promising Kern County seniors they can freeze property taxes or skip school-bond charges are circulating online.** Kern County officials say the videos, which promote a non-existent form called “1098-SR,” are already generating calls and walk-ins at the assessor-recorder’s office. While some states offer similar property tax programs, California does not. The videos appear on platforms like YouTube and feature what seem to be real people explaining programs that do not exist in California. Kern County Assessor-Recorder Laura Avila says her office has not confirmed anyone losing money or being asked to pay, but she is calling this a preventive advisory.

**KGET 17 tells us that Senators Schiff and Padilla announced $43 million in funding to Kern County’s Amtrak Gold Runner Route.** This investment will enhance local transportation infrastructure and provide residents with improved access to regional travel options.

**23ABC says deputies arrested a man after finding 216 pounds of methamphetamine, 2 pounds of marijuana, a gun, and a methamphetamine conversion lab inside a California City home.** Juan Manuel Castro Lopez, 54, of Sinaloa, Mexico, faces charges including manufacturing a controlled substance and possession of a controlled substance for the purposes of sales. Authorities searched the home on Camp Fire Drive on Monday. The lab was dismantled, and the residence was tagged as unsafe for occupying.

## Something good

Senators Schiff and Padilla announced $43 million in funding for Kern County’s Amtrak Gold Runner Route. This investment will enhance the local transportation infrastructure and provide residents with improved access to regional travel options.

## Coming up this week

The Multi Modal Transportation And Traffic Safety Committee meets today at 12:00 p.m. The Historic Preservation Commission meets today at 4:00 p.m. The Miscellaneous Civil Service Commission meets today at 2:00 p.m. The Planning Commission meets on Thursday, August 20, at 5:30 p.m. The Water Board meets on Wednesday, August 19, at 10:00 a.m.

On the entertainment front, Los Yonic’s Zamacona, Los caminantes, y Grupo Yndio will perform at the Fox Theater on Sunday, August 22. Cults & Classics: Season Pass 2026-2027 will be at the Fox Theater on Tuesday, August 24. Rodney Carrington will take the stage at the Fox Theater on Thursday, August 27. CUMBIATRON: THE CUMBIA RAVE will be at the Fox Theater on Friday, August 28. Willie Barcena will perform at the Fox Theater on Saturday, August 29. Michael Return Of The King Tribute Featuring Michael Phoenix will be at the Fox Theater on Saturday, August 29.
